아이.forms: 아이가 · 아이를 · short: 애 · plural: 아이들
아이.x: The child is playing in the park.
아이.e: Often shortened to 애 in speech; 아이들 = children.

배탈.ex: 어제 찬 음식을 너무 많이 먹어서 배탈이 났어요.
배탈.x: I ate too much cold food yesterday and got an upset stomach.
배탈.t: It almost always appears as 배탈이 나다, 'to get an upset stomach.'

선수.ex: 그 선수는 우리 팀에서 제일 빨라요.
선수.x: That player is the fastest on our team.
선수.e: Literally 'chosen hand' — someone picked for their skill.

여러.forms: 여러 + noun: 여러 사람 · 여러 가지
여러.x: I met friends from many different countries.
여러.t: 여러 always comes right before a noun; it can't stand alone or take particles.

전체.ex: 우리 반 전체가 함께 소풍을 갔어요.
전체.x: Our whole class went on a picnic together.
전체.t: 전체 is a noun for 'the whole'; for adverbial 'all' use 전부 or 모두.

마감.ex: 보고서 마감이 내일이라서 오늘 밤에 써야 해요.
마감.x: The report is due tomorrow, so I have to write it tonight.
마감.t: It also means closing time: 오늘 영업 마감 means 'closed for today'.

이별.ex: 사랑하는 사람과의 이별은 언제나 슬프고 힘들어요.
이별.x: Parting from someone you love is always sad and hard.

이후.ex: 졸업 이후에 한 번도 그 친구를 못 만났어요.
이후.x: I haven't seen that friend even once since graduation.

점차.forms: 점차 + change verb: 점차 늘어나다, 점차 좋아지다
점차.ex: 봄이 오면서 날씨가 점차 따뜻해지고 있어요.
점차.x: With spring coming, the weather is gradually getting warmer.
점차.t: 점차 sounds a bit more formal than 점점; both pair with verbs of change like -아/어지다.

상당히.x: This exam was quite a bit harder than the last one.
상당히.e: Literally 'matching up', so a considerable amount.

나타내다.m: to show, to express, to represent, to indicate
나타내다.x: This graph shows the change in population.
나타내다.e: From 나타나다 'to appear': to make something appear.

곤란하다.m: awkward, difficult, in a tough spot
곤란하다.x: That question is a bit hard for me to answer.
곤란하다.t: Pronounced [골란하다]; 그건 좀 곤란해요 is a soft, polite way to say no.

자연재해.ex: 지진이나 홍수 같은 자연재해는 미리 막기 어려워요.
자연재해.x: Natural disasters like earthquakes and floods are hard to prevent in advance.

앞두다.m: to have (an event) ahead, be just before
앞두다.ex: 결혼을 앞두고 요즘 준비할 게 많아요.
앞두다.x: With my wedding coming up, I have a lot to prepare these days.
앞두다.e: 앞 'front' + 두다 'to put' — something placed just ahead of you.
앞두다.t: Almost always used as N을/를 앞두고 'with N just ahead': 시험을 앞두고.

간접적.x: He indirectly let me know he was saying no.
간접적.e: Literally 'touching through something in between'. -적 = '-ic, -al': 경제적, 문화적.

연금.x: My grandfather receives a pension every month.
연금.e: Literally 'yearly money' — paid regularly after retirement.

학생회.x: The student council is preparing the school festival.

후보.ex: 그 배우는 올해 여우주연상 후보에 올랐어요.
후보.x: That actress was nominated for Best Actress this year.
후보.t: 후보에 오르다 means 'to be nominated'; in elections, 후보 means 'candidate'.

허전하다.x: Now that my roommate has moved out, the room feels empty.
허전하다.t: Also used when something usual is missing: 시계가 없으니까 손목이 허전해요.

섭섭함.m: hurt feelings, disappointment (at being neglected); sadness at parting
섭섭함.ex: 친구가 내 생일을 잊어버려서 섭섭함을 느꼈어요.
섭섭함.x: My friend forgot my birthday, so I felt hurt.
섭섭함.e: Noun from 섭섭하다 'hurt, sad to part' + -ㅁ.
섭섭함.t: Pronounced [섭써팜] — ㅂ + ㅎ merge into ㅍ.

기질.ex: 그는 어릴 때부터 예술가 기질이 있었어요.
기질.x: He's had an artistic temperament since he was young.
기질.e: Literally 'spirit and substance' — the temperament you are born with.
기질.t: Often 'N 기질': 리더 기질, 예술가 기질 — a natural tendency to be like N.

가식적.ex: 가식적인 칭찬은 별로 듣고 싶지 않아요.
가식적.x: I don't really want to hear fake compliments.
가식적.t: Pronounced [가식쩍]; a common criticism of celebrities who seem fake.

두루.m: widely, all around, extensively, to everyone
두루.ex: 그는 여러 분야의 지식을 두루 갖추고 있어요.
두루.x: He has broad knowledge across many fields.

마비되다.m: to be paralyzed, to be numb; to be brought to a standstill
마비되다.ex: 폭설 때문에 시내 교통이 완전히 마비됐어요.
마비되다.x: Downtown traffic was completely paralyzed by the heavy snow.
마비되다.t: Used for bodies and for systems: 교통이 마비되다, 기능이 마비되다.

부여하다.m: to grant, to give, to assign (a right, meaning, role)
부여하다.ex: 회사는 직원들에게 더 많은 권한을 부여했습니다.
부여하다.x: The company gave its employees more authority.
부여하다.e: Literally 'attach and give' — handing over something abstract like rights or meaning.
부여하다.t: Used with abstract objects: 권한, 의미, 자격, 기회 — not for handing someone a physical item.

갈라지다.m: to split, to crack; to break up, to be divided
갈라지다.x: The rice paddies cracked because of the drought.

허점.ex: 그 계획에는 몇 가지 허점이 있어요.
허점.x: That plan has a few weak spots.
허점.e: Literally 'empty point': a gap someone can slip through.

진열.ex: 새로 나온 상품을 가게 앞에 진열했어요.
진열.x: We displayed the new products at the front of the store.
진열.t: Pronounced [지녈]: the ㄴ carries over to the next syllable.

운임.x: Starting next month, bus fares will go up.

처가.m: wife's family, in-laws' home (from the husband's view)
처가.x: I visited my wife's family with her over the weekend.
처가.e: Literally 'wife's house.' 처- marks the wife's side: 처남, 처제.
처가.t: The polite form is 처가댁; 처갓집 is a common everyday variant.

비건.ex: 저는 비건이라서 고기랑 우유를 안 먹어요.
비건.x: I'm vegan, so I don't eat meat or drink milk.
비건.t: Often used before nouns: 비건 식당 'vegan restaurant', 비건 화장품 'vegan cosmetics'. The general word for a vegetarian is 채식주의자.

보슬보슬.x: A fine spring rain has been drizzling since morning.
보슬보슬.e: 의태어 (manner word) for fine, soft rain. The dark-vowel pair 부슬부슬 sounds a little heavier and gloomier.
보슬보슬.t: A light drizzle like this is called 보슬비. The opposite feel is 주룩주룩 for heavy rain.

지끈지끈.ex: 잠을 못 자서 머리가 지끈지끈 아파요.
지끈지끈.x: I couldn't sleep, so my head is throbbing.
지끈지끈.e: 의태어 (manner word) for a pounding, splitting pain, almost always in the head.
지끈지끈.t: The verb 지끈거리다 is common: 머리가 지끈거려요 'I have a pounding headache'.

전동 킥보드.ex: 전동 킥보드를 탈 때는 꼭 헬멧을 쓰세요.
전동 킥보드.x: Always wear a helmet when you ride an electric scooter.
전동 킥보드.e: 전동 'electric-powered' (literally 'electric motion') + 킥보드, Konglish from 'kickboard' for a kick scooter.
전동 킥보드.t: By Korean law riders need at least a moped license and a helmet, and riding two on one scooter is banned.

거품.ex: 집값 거품이 꺼지면 경제에 큰 충격이 올 수 있어요.
거품.x: If the housing price bubble bursts, it could deal a big shock to the economy.
거품.e: The everyday word for foam or suds, as on beer or soap, extended to inflated prices.
거품.t: Collocations: 거품이 끼다 (a bubble forms) and 거품이 꺼지다 (a bubble bursts).

발주.m: placing an order (for goods or construction)
발주.x: City hall put out an order for the construction of a new bridge.
발주.t: Pronounced [발쭈] — ㅈ tenses after ㄹ in Sino-Korean words.

고의.ex: 그는 고의로 그런 것이 아니라고 말했어요.
고의.x: He said he didn't do it on purpose.
고의.t: 고의로 = on purpose, a formal version of 일부러; 고의적 = deliberate.

존엄.x: The dignity of every human being must be respected.
존엄.t: Seen in 존엄사 'death with dignity'; in everyday talk 존엄성 is more common.

휴전.x: The Korean War stopped with a ceasefire in 1953.
휴전.t: Korea's border is called 휴전선 'the ceasefire line' because the war never officially ended.

서민.m: ordinary people, common folk, working class
서민.ex: 정부는 서민을 위한 주택 정책을 발표했습니다.
서민.x: The government announced a housing policy for ordinary people.
서민.e: Literally 'the common people', as opposed to the elite.
서민.t: Often used warmly: 서민 음식 means cheap everyday food like 떡볶이 or 순대.

찬사.ex: 그 배우의 연기에 관객들의 찬사가 쏟아졌어요.
찬사.x: The audience poured out praise for that actor's performance.

철회하다.m: to withdraw, to retract, to revoke
철회하다.ex: 시민들의 반대로 정부는 그 계획을 철회했습니다.
철회하다.x: Due to citizens' opposition, the government withdrew the plan.
철회하다.e: Literally 'pull back and return' — taking back what you put forward.

그르치다.m: to spoil, to ruin, to botch
그르치다.ex: 작은 실수 하나가 일을 그르칠 수 있어요.
그르치다.x: One small mistake can ruin the whole thing.
그르치다.e: Related to 그르다 'wrong, hopeless': to make something go wrong.

얕잡다.m: to look down on, to underestimate (usually as 얕잡아 보다)
얕잡다.ex: 상대 팀을 얕잡아 보다가 경기에서 졌어요.
얕잡다.x: We underestimated the other team and lost the game.
얕잡다.e: 얕다 'shallow' + 잡다 'to reckon': reckoning someone too low.
얕잡다.t: Almost always used as 얕잡아 보다 or 얕잡아 여기다.

싱그럽다.m: fresh, refreshing (of greenery, air, scent or youth)
싱그럽다.ex: 비가 그친 뒤 숲에서 싱그러운 냄새가 났어요.
싱그럽다.x: After the rain stopped, the forest smelled fresh.
싱그럽다.t: Use 싱그럽다 for leaves, breezes and youthful smiles, but 싱싱하다 for fish and vegetables.

가물가물.ex: 그 사람 이름이 기억날 듯 말 듯 가물가물해요.
가물가물.x: That person's name is on the tip of my tongue, but it's fuzzy.
가물가물.e: Mimetic word; first describes something flickering faintly in the distance.
가물가물.t: Most common as 기억이 가물가물해요 'My memory is fuzzy.'

진보.ex: 그는 대학 시절부터 진보 정당을 지지해 왔어요.
진보.x: He has supported the progressive party since his college days.

흉악범.ex: 흉악범의 얼굴을 공개해야 한다는 의견이 많습니다.
흉악범.x: Many people think the faces of violent criminals should be made public.

불교.x: Buddhism came to Korea during the Three Kingdoms period.

본론.x: We don't have much time, so I'll get straight to the point.
본론.t: Pronounced [볼론]; 본론으로 들어가다 means 'to get down to business'.

술수.x: The public is tired of politicians' scheming.
술수.t: Pronounced [술쑤]; mostly negative, often in politics: 권모술수 means Machiavellian scheming.

초인플레이션.ex: 초인플레이션 때문에 빵 하나 값이 하루 만에 두 배가 됐어요.
초인플레이션.x: Because of hyperinflation, the price of a loaf of bread doubled in a single day.
초인플레이션.e: 초- 'super' + English 'inflation'; 초- is productive: 초고속, 초대형.

시민사회.ex: 시민사회 단체들이 정부 정책에 반대하는 성명을 냈습니다.
시민사회.x: Civil society groups issued a statement opposing the government policy.
시민사회.e: Literally 'citizens' society' — the space between government and business.

국제사법재판소.ex: 두 나라는 분쟁을 국제사법재판소에 맡기기로 했습니다.
국제사법재판소.x: The two countries decided to take their dispute to the International Court of Justice.
국제사법재판소.e: Literally 'international place for administering law and judging'.
국제사법재판소.t: Don't mix it up with 국제형사재판소 (ICC), which tries individuals, not states.

교단.ex: 그 교단은 전국에서 수백 개의 교회를 운영합니다.
교단.x: That religious body runs hundreds of churches nationwide.
교단.t: Don't confuse with the homonym in 교단에 서다, 'to stand at the lectern', meaning to work as a teacher.

투사.ex: 남을 탓하는 것은 자기 감정의 투사일 수 있어요.
투사.x: Blaming others may be a projection of your own feelings.
투사.e: Literally 'throwing and shooting out' your feelings onto others.
투사.t: Homonym warning: 투사 also means 'fighter' (e.g. 독립 투사, independence fighter).

중성자.x: A neutron is a particle with no electric charge.

나노기술.ex: 나노기술은 의료와 전자 분야에서 널리 쓰입니다.
나노기술.x: Nanotechnology is widely used in medicine and electronics.

설화.ex: 이 마을에는 산신령에 관한 설화가 전해 내려와요.
설화.x: A tale about the mountain spirit has been handed down in this village.
설화.e: An umbrella term for myths 신화, legends 전설 and folktales 민담.

질감.ex: 이 화가는 물감을 두껍게 칠해서 거친 질감을 살렸어요.
질감.x: This painter applied paint thickly to bring out a rough texture.

점입가경.m: getting better and better; (ironically) going from bad to worse
점입가경.ex: 드라마가 갈수록 점입가경이라 다음 회가 기다려져요.
점입가경.x: The drama keeps getting better, so I can't wait for the next episode.
점입가경.t: Often sarcastic today: 갈수록 점입가경이다 'it just keeps getting more absurd'.

반추하다.m: to ruminate, to reflect on; to chew the cud
반추하다.x: He quietly reflected on past events.
반추하다.e: Literally 'bring fodder back' — how cows chew the cud.
rel: to reflect on, to mull over

음험하다.x: He smiled on the outside, but inside he was sinister.

계보.m: genealogy, lineage; line (of tradition or thought)
계보.ex: 이 작가는 한국 현대 문학의 계보를 잇고 있어요.
계보.x: This writer carries on the lineage of modern Korean literature.
계보.t: Common collocation: 계보를 잇다 'to carry on the line of'.

무위.x: All the effort so far ended up coming to nothing.
무위.e: Literally 'no doing'; also the Taoist ideal of effortless non-action.
무위.t: Common pattern: 무위로 돌아가다/끝나다 'to come to nothing'.
